description:
FILED s422, measured while closing #419.

#419 removed the READ error: t/re/pat.t's emitted CL is now valid UTF-8 and
SBCL loads it.  The 1263 rows are still NOT there, and the measurement says
why -- there are two more walls, in this order.

WALL 1 -- SBCL's DEFAULT 1 GB DYNAMIC SPACE.  With the runners as shipped
(`tools/run-perl-suite.pl re/pat.t --jobs 1 --timeout 900`) the run ends in

    Heap exhausted during garbage collection: 0 bytes available, 32 requested.
    ... dynamic_space_size = 1073741824 ... bytes_allocated = 1037682864

and the runner records `C: 0/0  DIFF` with an EMPTY signature and
"PCL produced no TAP output" -- SBCL dies hard, so nothing that had been
printed is flushed.  None of the five runners passes --dynamic-space-size
(tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm sets only --control-stack-size 512), so this is the
SBCL default, not a PCL setting.

MEASUREMENT (s422, measurement-only edit to PCLSbcl, reverted in the same
session): with `--dynamic-space-size 3072` the same command gives

    re/pat.t   P:1263/4   C: 225/140   DIFF
    crash:simple-error: Failed to match at <...>/t/re/pat.t line <N>

i.e. 365 TAP rows appear, and then WALL 2.

WALL 2 -- a `Failed to match` die after ~365 rows.  The message text is NOT
in re/pat.t, NOT in perl's t/ or lib/, NOT in the emitted CL, and NOT in
PCL's .lisp sources or /usr/share/common-lisp (all grepped s422) -- so it is
built at run time (a die whose argument is concatenated) or comes from a
module PCL loads.  Locating it needs a live capture: re-run with the bigger
heap and dump the PCL side's full stderr (the runner keeps only the
normalised signature).

WHAT NEEDS DECIDING (not an Opus call): raising the dynamic space is a
RUNNER change -- tools/lib/PCLSbcl.pm is the one command-line builder for
all five runners, and the memory budget is shared (the companion suite
already runs inside a MemoryMax=10G systemd scope and `--all --jobs 8` can
OOM it; s399/#324 is the precedent for what a per-runner drift costs).  A
number picked for pat.t multiplies by the job count everywhere.  Options:
  (a) raise $DYNAMIC_MB in PCLSbcl for every runner (one decision, one
      place -- the file's own stated purpose) and re-measure the OOM
      headroom at --jobs 4/8;
  (b) a per-file allowance beside docs/perl-suite-timeouts.tsv (a
      memory registry with the same shape: rel<TAB>MB<TAB>cause);
  (c) leave it and register the file.
Bar for whichever is chosen: the companion suite at its normal job count
without OOM, plus the gate and the sweep unchanged.

Prize: 1263 perl rows, of which 365 are already reachable at 3 GB.
title: t/re/pat.t: after #419 the file LOADS but hits SBCL's 1 GB heap (0 rows); 3 GB gives 225/140 then a `Failed to match` die
